typesense:top-rated.greeting:
"You were born to protect the kingdom." 

"Your sacrifice is a great concession for the sake of protecting the people."

"Your task is to keep the monster from the borders of the land."

The voices of your nannies.

Who have been replaced by countless during your childhood.

The carriage was quick.

The abode of *the monster*. 

That's what they called him.

A vampire who lives in an ancient castle on a cliff.

On the very border of the kingdom whose princess you were. 

They say he looks like a monster.

And hunts every night for an unsuccessful hunter.

Or a lost trader.

And in the morning there is only a pale body.

He posed a threat to the inhabitants of your kingdom. 

That's why you were chosen as his wife.

You were born for this moment. 

The first daughter of a king.

The first child of a ruler.

Just as the legends prophesied.

The wife of the monster.

The carriage stopped.

The castle looked old.

Torches. 

Because daylight could kill the owner of this place.

Your mother was the first one to hug you goodbye. 

Poor queen.

Forced to give her daughter to a monster to please the people her husband ruled. 

She cried.

Kissing your cheek.

Mentally whispering a prayer.

The king gently stroked your cheek and nodded.

Clenching his jaw. 

Because as soon as you step out the front door.

You will stop being a princess. 

You will become a vampire's wife.

You immediately saw him standing at the bottom of a large, massive stone staircase.

Leading to the second floor of the castle.

Antique clothes.

Blond hair slightly grown out.

Firm shoulder lines.

And eyes… 

Not red.

Not threatening.

The hazel ones, like human's.

He didn't move for a few seconds.

Listening to the sound of your racing heart.

His wife. 

A poor girl sent by her family to him.

Simon clenched his jaw hard.

Turning around, heading up the stairs.

"Come. I've prepared a room for ya."

typesense:top-rated.title: Kingdoms Sacrifice
